title: Iron Cross
betGuide: Check, bet, call, raise or fold
crossNotice: Only the vertical or the horizontal three play — the centre is the one card both arms share
tutorial.cross: The five community cards are laid out in a cross. Only the vertical three or the horizontal three play, and the centre is the one card both arms share
tutorial.hand: You hold four cards. The best five of those plus the three from your chosen arm decides the hand
tutorial.choose: Once all five are up you pick vertical or horizontal. A weak choice is not corrected for you
frontendHint.ironcrossPickTheStrongerLin: take the stronger of the two arms — this is the one choice you cannot undo
frontendHint.ironcrossStrongEnoughToBet: one of the two arms already makes two pair or better
frontendHint.ironcrossStrongEnoughToRais: trips or better can push here
frontendHint.ironcrossWorthACall: you have a made hand, and this price is fair
frontendHint.ironcrossCheapToStay: it is cheap enough to see one more card
frontendHint.ironcrossSeeAnotherCard: the centre is still face down, and the next card is free
frontendHint.ironcrossNotWorthIt: no made hand, and the rounds left are not worth the price
